primary_experiment.oracle: shared Runner.expected_query/assert_query using seed spec + dynamic map; title order independently verified by PostgreSQL
primary_experiment.state_guard: baseline snapshot + shared preflight; post-batch full equality; shared final restore; project lock, no parallel mutation
primary_experiment.cache_policy: keep baseline cache configuration; no cache flush; no extra warmup beyond common preflight
measurement: target wall time incl pacing, decoding, oracle and recording
API request elapsed incl response read
shell lifecycle HTTP attempts incl auth (no headers/body)
end-to-end invocation stopwatch; metadata seconds retained
primary_experiment.analysis: report all 6 runs and per-round ratios, median/min/max; no statistical generalization from n=3
primary_experiment.failure_policy: retain failed/incomplete run, stop dependent measurements on precondition/restore/network failure; no blanket skips; changes after measurements require a new protocol version or explicitly separate pilot
primary_experiment.human_effort: not measured; do not convert agent/session wall time into person-hours or currency

historical_comparison.comparison_unit: strategies incl guided stateful, not guidance alone
historical_comparison.qualification: same recorded image/budget/actor/fixture snapshots; dirty historical source not frozen byte-for-byte, no claim causal isolation or current runtime validation
historical_comparison.interrupted_alternative_guided: 20261012T122826Z-22781 (report interruption separately, do not merge with primary cohort)

replay_evaluation.rule: compare task scope and measured wall/runner times separately; no claim equal discovery power or time-to-first-failure from full-campaign duration

budget_or_baseline_changes: query-only measurement cap recorded here; main campaign budget, schema, policy, fixture and raw/guided phases unchanged
